SMS — A2P / P2P short-message-service (incl. 10DLC, powerpacks, toll-free)

Usage:
  plivo messaging sms [command]

Available Commands:
  10dlc       US A2P 10DLC registration — brands, campaigns, links
  diagnose    Diagnose what happened with an SMS (AI-powered)
  list        List SMS messages
  powerpacks  Powerpacks — number pools for high-volume SMS
  send        Send an SMS (defaults to dry-run; pass --yes to actually send)
  tollfree    Toll-free verification (US TFN messaging compliance)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for sms

Global Flags:
      --all                auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run            print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain            explain what the command will do before executing
      --log-level string   log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color           disable colored output
  -o, --output string      output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string     named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet              suppress non-data output
      --timeout int        request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo messaging sms [command] --help" for more information about a command.
